d:
In the magical voice of Javed Ali, presenting ‘Woh Khuda’ from ‘8 A.M. Metro’. Featuring Gulshan Devaiah and Saiyami Kher in the movie, the track is co-sung by Shahbaaz Khan, composed by Mark K Robin and penned by Shahbaaz Khan and Manoj Kumar Juloori.
Music Composed, Arranged & produced by Mark K Robin
Lyricist- Shahbaaz Khan & Manoj Juloori
Singers – Javed Ali
Bass & electric guitar - Mark K Robin
String instruments- SM Subhani
Rhythms - Pawan
Live band - Jabri Marfa
